title: llm.diarize
description: Speaker diarization through the configured backend (explicit provider > DEFAULT_DIARIZATION_PROVIDER; single provider, no fallback chain). comm carries URLs only, never raw audio bytes. Returns {status: 'ok', diarization: NormalizedDiarization, provider_used: string} or {status: 'failure', reason: string}. Turns are who-spoke-when only — fusing them with STT words (merge policy) is the caller's job.

audio_url.description: Fetchable audio URL (presigned S3/MinIO GET). comm carries URLs only, never raw bytes.

num_speakers.description: Exact speaker count hint; omit to let the provider decide. Bound hints (min_speakers/max_speakers) travel via provider_options and are mutually exclusive with the exact count.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard cap on the diarization request.

audio_content_hash.description: Content hash of the audio (``sha256:<hex>``) — the checkpoint key that makes a retry of this priced call free. See the same field on llm.transcribe.

audio_offset_ms.description: Where this audio sits inside a LONGER recording, in milliseconds. Pass it only when you are submitting a piece of something: the checkpoint key is derived from the audio's content, and two chunks of a repeated passage (a looped fixture, a tone, a silence) are byte-identical, so without an offset the second call is served the first one's transcript — with the first one's timestamps, and a hole where the second chunk should be. Omit it for a whole recording.

provider_options.description: Free-form per-provider passthrough, applied AFTER the adapter's own request params — pin provider specifics without a core release. Unknown keys go to the provider as-is.

user_id.description: Who this call is for — recorded on the PromptLog row so per-user cost is answerable. Opaque to this package: any id shape the host uses. Optional; omitting it leaves the row unattributed, never rejected.

workspace_id.description: Which tenant this call is for — recorded on the PromptLog row so per-workspace cost is answerable without summing over its members. Optional, opaque, recorded only.
